subject: AI Leaders Dinner in Denver
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw you'll be in Denver for CVPR. We're hosting a small dinner on Sat, June
6 at Michelin-starred Guard & Grace - a relaxed evening with a handful of
CxOs and tech leads from the conference.

For context, Encord is the data layer for physical AI, helping 300+ teams
build a data flywheel from real-world robot data.

Can I save you a seat?

subject: [COMPANY] Corp's AI Model Development - Solving Data Challenges
text:
Dear [NAME],

I have been following [COMPANY] Corp's expansion closely - in particular the
HD Skin Analysis launch and the expansion into real-time face tracking and
virtual try-on across beauty and fashion. Building proprietary deep
learning models that perform accurately across diverse skin tones, lighting
conditions, and the full range of global users can be a significant data
challenge.

We have been working with companies like Synthesia, Vida ID, and Tractable
to help them solve challenges like this - specifically on the data
curation, annotation, and model evaluation side.

Would you be open to a 15-minute call to explore whether there is any
overlap?

subject: Encord — a few conversations across the data team at AutoScout24
text:
Hi [NAME],

Over the past couple of weeks I've had conversations with a few people
across the data team - a platform engineer who felt the work we are doing
on the data curation, annotation, and model evaluation side could be
beneficial for the data science team, and a data analyst who was open to
exploring how Encord could be beneficial for final stages of model
validation. I know you are working on improving the organisational elements
of the company so thought to reach out!

We work with Tractable, Automotus, and Toyota on training, curating, and
evaluating their models - and given the work happening at AutoScout24, I
thought it could be a relevant conversation.

Would you be open to a brief 15 minute call on Wednesday or Thursday this
week?

Wishing you a great week ahead!

subject: CV at [COMPANY]
text:
Good afternoon [NAME],

I came across [COMPANY]'s work on the A-BIOMASS camera - specifically
building underwater CV across species and geographies - which is very
interesting work.

We work with teams like Zeitview, Aigen and Abyss Solutions on data
annotation, curation, and model evaluation for similar applied CV
challenges - it would be great to share how we've been working with them
and hear more about how you're approaching that side of things at Ace
Aquatec.

Please let me know if you would be open to speaking for 15 minutes this
week?

subject: [COMPANY] Intro via Colleague - Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

I hope you are well today!

My colleague and I had a call with Arslan Mehboob on the Data Engineering
team a few weeks ago - he was interested to learn more about Encord on the
data curation, annotation and model evaluation side. He thought what we do
should be explored by the Data Science at [COMPANY] team so pointed us in
your direction.

We are currently working with teams like Tractable, Automotus, and Toyota
and knowing that your Data Science team is applying neural architectures to
things like vehicle image quality, classification, and fraud detection
across listings, I thought it could be worth a conversation.

Would you be open to a brief 15-minute call this week?

subject: Encord - spoke with Cristina
text:
Hi [NAME] - pleasure to meet,  

 Our teams connected at our recent event in Munich with your colleague Cristina García, who suggested you would be a great person for us to speak with.  

 Encord has helped leading ADAS teams such as Woven by Toyota by providing a scalable data management platform to help teams gain greater control of their their annotation QA processes & support frontier use cases such as VLA reasoning + 3D auto-labelling.  

 I understand this may be a good time to pick up the conversation around these areas.  

 Would you be available to meet next week?

subject: Scaling perception data pipelines // learnings from Genesis & Boston Dynamics
text:
Hi [NAME], 

Noticed [COMPANY] AI is scaling its physical AI capabilities this year & thought it could be worth a quick intro. 

 For context, Encord works with leading Physical AI teams, including Boston Dynamics, Genesis, and Dyna, providing data collection, platform, and HITL services to help scale their multimodal annotation pipelines. Teams we work with typically complete model training and evaluation 60% faster. 

 Would you be open to having a quick chat next Tuesday or Wednesday? Happy to share how we support the humanoid/industrial robotics team as you grow the AI/ML team.
